newsitem.title: USA: Guidant, Medtronic rally on fund buying.
newsitem.headline: Guidant, Medtronic rally on fund buying.

text.p: Shares in Guidant Corp and Medtronic Inc rose Tuesday on strong institutional buying as growth fund managers shifted out of high-technology issues and into top-tier medical technology stocks.
"The market is coming back to the medical tech stocks," said PaineWebber medical technology analyst David Lothson.
Shares in Indianapolis-based Guidant closed up 3-1/4 to a new 52-week high of 64-1/4. Minneapolis-based Medtronic was up 1-3/4 to 69-1/8, near a yearly high.
Both companies said they made no announcements Tuesday.

"What we've seen in the past two or three days is as some of the tech stocks get hit, growth portfolio managers are looking for somewhere to put their money," said J.P. Morgan Securities medical technology analyst Michael Weinstein.
Johnson & Johnson and Boston Scientific Corp shares also are rallying, analysts said.
